articles.title: Woman claims 2.5 acres was ancestral after stepmother sold it; why HC rejected plea
articles.summary: The Madras High Court held that the property was not ancestral but self-acquired. As a result, under Hindu law, the man and his mother were legally entitled to execute the gift settlement deed in favour of the man’s second wife, who could subsequently sell the property.

articles.title: GST relief for overseas R&D: Why new place-of-supply rules could boost India’s engineering sector

articles.title: GST taxable supply rises 25.8% as effective tax rate falls: What the numbers say about GST 2.0

articles.title: As Trump sours H-1B visa dream, which Indian IT professionals face biggest hit?
articles.summary: Three H-1B related changes are stacking on top of each other: the multiple $100,000 fee proposals, the wage-weighted lottery favoring more senior workers, new layoff and compliance scrutiny, and now the OPT/STEM-OPT $70,000 fee proposal for students looking to work in the US.

articles.title: GST Council removes arrest power, raises prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore: What changes for taxpayers
articles.summary: The 57th GST Council meeting decided to remove the power of arrest under GST. At the same time, the threshold for prosecution will be increased from ₹1 crore to ₹5 crore, significantly raising the level at which a taxpayer could face prosecution.

articles.title: GST Council scraps tax officers' arrest powers; prosecution threshold raised to Rs 5 cr
